argument: The remembered turn must be carried by the downstream silhouette and leg axis, not by the lime hinge pin or the fold line drawn over a stable body.
A caption-free viewer should identify one animal whose rear contour and feet share a changed axis; if the hinge reads as a decorative joint, the mutation fails.
A visitor hinge must change later contour points and route coordinates, while unhinging it must restore the exact prior state from both pointer and keyboard paths.
A bend is an easy metaphor. Delete v005 if hiding the pins leaves only a pretty kink, or if the prose explains more consequence than the SVG body can show.
